scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c auto "npm --workspace apps/api run dev" "npm --workspace apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/web run build && npm --workspace apps/api run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/api run typecheck
scripts.test:gate: npm run typecheck && npm run test:schema && npm run test:core && npm run test:performance && npm run build && npm run test:ui
